title: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were act
question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?

prediction.sql:
WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  WHERE state = 'LA'
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
serving AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.id_bioguide,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2025-12-31') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(ft.first_start,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS years_elapsed
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN first_term ft ON ft.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
  JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'M'
    AND t.state = 'LA'
    AND t.term_start <= '2025-12-31'
    AND (t.term_end IS NULL OR t.term_end = '' OR t.term_end >= '2025-12-31')
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS n
FROM serving
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT t.id_bioguide,
         MIN(CAST(substr(t.term_start,1,4) AS INTEGER)) AS first_year
  FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND t.state = 'LA'
  GROUP BY t.id_bioguide
),
serving AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         t.id_bioguide,
         CAST(substr(t.term_start,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS y
  FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND t.state = 'LA'
    AND t.term_start <= (CAST(substr(t.term_start,1,4) AS INTEGER) || '-12-31')
    AND (t.term_end IS NULL OR t.term_end >= (CAST(substr(t.term_start,1,4) AS INTEGER) || '-12-31'))
)
SELECT (s.y - f.first_year) AS years_elapsed,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.id_bioguide) AS num_legislators
FROM serving s
JOIN first_term f ON f.id_bioguide = s.id_bioguide
WHERE (s.y - f.first_year) > 30
  AND (s.y - f.first_year) < 50
GROUP BY (s.y - f.first_year)
ORDER BY (s.y - f.first_year);
